risk: Dead / Unconnected Process Steps in iFlow BPMN Definition
consequence: CallActivity_77 (GLOVIA_Conditioncheck_Salesorder_Create.groovy) and CallActivity_86 (Content Modifier extracting OrganizationId) exist in the flow XML with no incoming or outgoing sequence flows. Any expected validation or header extraction is skipped, resulting in invalid orders reaching mapping or downstream receivers.
mitigation: Unit test suite verifies order code checks directly and asserts on headers. The iFlow must be updated to wire CallActivity_77 and CallActivity_86 immediately after CallActivity_4 before the parallel/exclusive gateways.

risk: Silent Routing Failures via Externalized Route Properties
consequence: Routing rules {{Glovia_Route_SalesOrder}} and {{Glovia_Route2_ReturnSalesOrder}} depend on external configuration parameters. If misconfigured or referencing non-existent properties, messages fall through to SequenceFlow_110 (Default Escalation) or terminate unexpectedly.
mitigation: SCENARIO-03 explicitly validates the EscalationEndEvent path to ensure that when conditions are unfulfilled, an escalation with ErrorCode RoutingConditionNotMet is raised rather than quietly discarding messages.

consequence: Participants Participant_2 (CreateOrder Details REST) and Participant_112 (SOReturns Details REST) are defined as EndpointReceivers in Collaboration_1 but have no connecting Message Flows from EndEvent_2 or EndEvent_9. Messages terminate at the end event without actually dispatching to destination systems.
mitigation: Add request validation assertions confirming target delivery headers and flag missing target message flows in integration pipeline checks.

consequence: In SubProcess_91, CallActivity_97 overwrites the message body with ${property.InputPayload}. If an error occurs in CallActivity_4 before InputPayload is initialized, CallActivity_97 sets the body to null/empty string, preventing Log_Payload.gsh from recording diagnostic data.
mitigation: Test case test_exception_subprocess_triggered exercises the exception path, verifying that InputPayload retention is verified even under boundary error states.
